name: Finta
tagline: Bank, card and brokerage data your agent can read and categorize.
description: Finta syncs bank, credit card and brokerage accounts into Notion, Airtable, Google Sheets and Coda. Its hosted MCP server and REST API let agents read balances, transactions, holdings and debts, and categorize transactions, manage categories and rules, and update manual accounts. It never moves money or changes bank connections.

methods.label: OAuth 2.0
methods.note: The MCP server opens a Finta sign-in window in OAuth-capable clients; there is no token to copy.

methods.label: API key
methods.note: For the REST API. Sent as a Bearer token; keys start with finta_.

auth.guide:
**MCP with OAuth (fastest):** add `https://mcp.finta.io/mcp` to an OAuth-capable client. On first use the client opens a Finta sign-in window. Approve access and the connection is remembered. There is no API key or token to copy.

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http finta https://mcp.finta.io/mcp
```

In Claude Code, run `/mcp`, select **finta**, choose **Authenticate**, and sign in when the browser opens.

**API key (REST):** create a key in [API settings](https://app.finta.io/settings/api). Keys start with `finta_` and go in a Bearer header:

```bash
curl https://api.finta.io/v2/me \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FINTA_API_KEY"
```

**Gotchas:** the Finta account needs an active subscription or trial. The MCP consent screen asks which accounts the client can read, and tools only see those accounts; an API key can be limited the same way, and requests for other accounts return `404`. Change MCP access or disconnect a client on the [MCP page](https://app.finta.io/mcp). Both read data Finta has already synced, not the bank live, so a transaction that hasn't synced yet won't show up. Writes change categories, rules, transaction categories and manual accounts only. Nothing moves money or touches bank connections.
